author: awesome_apricot
body:
A CTW map made by myself, Falcon and Spooks. 

Pictures below. 

Welcome to suggestions or questions, i.e why did you do this?

Eric has been on and "accepted" the map, however we're willing for more feedback. 

The green glass is the height limit. 

The white glass is the regions where building IS allowed. 

You spawn next to each other and work your way out in opposite directions. Will make a video showing. 

Pictures: 

https://imgur.com/a/ZXARO

Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/g78emvvkhhy6wqs/VendettaV2%20-%20Copy.rar?dl=0

YML: Eric said he will do the babe.

replies.author: chle_
replies.body:
I think there is waayyy more to improve before this map gets played. As for now, it wont play that great.

There is almost no elevation to the map, which makes it very easy to blockspam. The amount of blocks in the spawnkit is too high, and can result in normal, boring gameplay (not TE gameplay). The lane to the woolroom is too long. I would recomend to shorten it by about 15 blocks, removing the bedrock wall and elevating the lane to it.
The map is kinda poor in aestethics, and imo you have chosen the wrong building blocks. (But thats just a side thing)

Besides that, I think the map has a neat shape!
Good luck with it!
+0,35
